skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the basic concepts and principles of international taxation, including double taxation, tax treaties, transfer pricing, international tax competition, anti-dumping and countervailing duties, and foreign contractor taxes.
Read and understand standard documents related to current tax policies and model tax treaties from OECD, UN, and the US.
Analyze the practical issues of tax management in the context of globalization, including foreign direct investment and international trade policies.
Apply professional knowledge to analyze and propose solutions for current issues in international taxation.
Demonstrate the ability to work in a team, share information, and use group information to solve problems.
Show initiative in learning, answering questions, choosing topics, gathering data, analyzing data, and presenting results.
